correctness.rationale: Riemann--Hurwitz gives genus six; valuations yield six holomorphic differentials; exact Cartier square-extraction gives a block semilinear matrix. Squarefreeness forces the two W-images independent. The determinant of its V-square block is Delta^(1/4), and the following rank-one semilinear scalar vanishes exactly when E=0, proving all three full rank sequences over any algebraically closed characteristic-two field. A 12288-case exhaustive GF4 check and three independent zeta-count checks corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The natural full degree-seven cyclic trigonal coefficient family has constant first Cartier rank, yet admits three nonempty p-rank values 4,2,0 with distinct higher nilpotent filtration. Explicit smooth irreducible divisor and codimension-two graph equations classify all strata and reveal a genuine geometric boundary that cannot be read from the earlier known constant a-number. The result is a complete and potentially reusable algebraic stratification, not a degree-increment or an isolated numerical example.
